correctness.rationale: Read frozen RESULT.md with explicit tent shear f_eta, H_eta coordinates and Haar initial measure. The area-preserving triangular-shear change of variables makes (Y0,Y1)=(y,v) independent Haar, with X0=v-y-f_eta(y), X2=v-y+f_eta(v). Character expectations factor exactly into J_eta(k-l,k)J_eta(l-k,l), J_eta(m,r)=(1-eta)E(r+m(1-eta))+eta E(r-m eta), E(t)=∫e^{2πitz}dz. This representation handles removable denominator singularities. The tent map pushes Haar onto Haar, hence all C(k,k)=0 for k nonzero and X2-X0 is Haar; C(1,-1)=sin²(2πη)/[π²(3-2η)²(1-2η)²]>0, so observations not independent. C(1,2) negative formula gives d_TV≥|C|/2~eta/6; at eta=0 the cat linear map X2=2X0+3Y0 makes independent pair. Independent 100 direct-original-coordinate Fourier grid quadratures agreed within stated grid tolerances. Analytic factorization, not quadratures, covers all frequencies and parameters.
